tasks.label: fix-nuget
tasks.command: Remove-Item -Force 'build\windows\x64\nuget.exe' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force 'build\windows\x64\packages' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'Limpieza lista'; $url = 'https://dist.nuget.org/win-x86-commandline/latest/nuget.exe'; $dest = 'build\windows\x64\nuget.exe'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force 'build\windows\x64' | Out-Null; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $dest -UseBasicParsing; $size = (Get-Item $dest).Length; Write-Host "Descargado nuget.exe: $size bytes"; if ($size -lt 100000) { Write-Host 'ERROR: archivo demasiado pequeño' } else { Write-Host 'OK: nuget.exe listo' }

tasks.label: clean-cmake
